summary: This note covers the 2012 facelift of the Lexus RX crossover. It describes the design patent filed in January 2011, the reveal at the March 2012 Geneva Motor Show, and the cosmetic and feature changes. It also notes the introduction of the F Sport variant and the staggered worldwide sales start in 2012.
one_line: Describes the 2012 facelift of the Lexus RX, covering its design patent, styling changes, F Sport variant, and sales launch.
key_facts: A facelift of the Lexus RX was designed through late 2010.
The facelift was patented on 7 January 2011 under design registration number 001845801 - 0004.
The facelifted Lexus RX was unveiled at the March 2012 Geneva Motor Show.
The facelift included new wheels, interior colors, new head and tail lamps and new grilles.
New LED running lights were introduced on the facelifted Lexus RX.
The F Sport was introduced with a honeycomb grille, an 8-speed automatic transmission, and a unique sporty interior.
In the US, the facelifted model uses the Lexus Enform telematics system.
The Lexus Enform system in the US includes the Safety Connect SOS system and Shazam tagging.
Sales of the RX 350 and RX 450h began worldwide in April 2012.
Sales of the F Sport variants started in July 2012.
